title: Selected generator system squares are closed under contexts
statement: Fix $\ell\ne p$, the realization data and selected actual generator collection $G$ of [def-pur-realization-tree-shift-data], satisfying TreeGeneratorShiftLaws. Let $e,t$ be geometric independent expressions on a finite input family, let $K$ be admissible for both, and assume $K^{(i,r)}$ is also admissible for both. For actual maps $s,v,s^{\prime},v^{\prime}$ related by the selected TreeSynchronizedPair, the system square is $s^{\prime}\,s_t=s_e\,s[r]$ in diagrammatic order, with the exact treeSystemShift comparisons. This is an equality in the system category, before total limit.

proof.text: First check on each SynchronizedBasic constructor that the source and target occurrence-label multisets agree; induction preserves that fact through TreeSynchronizedPair. Induct on the selected TreeSynchronizedPair derivation using the optional variableContext on injectively labelled subexpressions. A selected label occurs in at most one child. If absent its update leaves the evaluation and the recorded generator components unchanged. For a basic generator containing the label, specialize TreeGeneratorShiftLaws to its actual contexts and endpoint equalities.

proof.text: For identity use the identity law. For composition paste the two system squares and retain the constructor's intermediate geometric, injectivity and both admissibility witnesses. At unary vertices map the child square and use naturality of the designated shift. Compact support uses its fixed open/proper composite and hidden open intermediate.

proof.text: At tensor vertices use the unique operand containing the selected occurrence and the comparison for that same tensor side. Apply naturality in both operands, including spectator changes, and bifunctoriality. Right-slot signs occur on both sides and are never replaced by unsigned comparisons. At independent root expressions the context endpoints are exactly treeSystemShift. No equation is detected by finite evaluation.

theorem realizationTreeSystemSquare (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (_hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (o : Operations l E) (R : Realizations l E D o)
    (G : TreeGenerators l E D o R)
    (_hGenerators : TreeGeneratorShiftLaws l E D o R G)
    {I : Type u} [Finite I] {X : I → Over (Spec (.of D.k))}
      {W : Over (Spec (.of D.k))} (e t : IndependentExpression _ I X W)
      (ge : e.val.geometric) (gt : t.val.geometric)
      (K : ∀ i, Integral l E (X i).left) (i : I) (r : ℤ)
      (he : e.val.domain l E o K) (ht : t.val.domain l E o K)
      (s : e.val.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj K) ⟶
        t.val.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj K))
      (v : (e.val.evaluate (integralInterpretation l E)).obj K ⟶
        (t.val.evaluate (integralInterpretation l E)).obj K)
      (sNew : e.val.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj
          (Function.update K i ((K i)⟦r⟧))) ⟶
        t.val.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj
          (Function.update K i ((K i)⟦r⟧))))
      (vNew : (e.val.evaluate (integralInterpretation l E)).obj
          (Function.update K i ((K i)⟦r⟧)) ⟶
        (t.val.evaluate (integralInterpretation l E)).obj
          (Function.update K i ((K i)⟦r⟧)))
      (pair : TreeSynchronizedPair l E o R.compositors R.openComparisons
        R.canonicalBridge R.properOpen
        R.ringedModels R.ringedOpenComparisons R.ringedProperOpen
        ((inputReduction l E X).obj K) K
        ((inputReduction l E X).obj (Function.update K i ((K i)⟦r⟧)))
        (Function.update K i ((K i)⟦r⟧))
        (G.selected ((inputReduction l E X).obj K) K
          ((inputReduction l E X).obj (Function.update K i ((K i)⟦r⟧)))
          (Function.update K i ((K i)⟦r⟧))) e.val t.val s v sNew vNew)
      (heNew : e.val.domain l E o (Function.update K i ((K i)⟦r⟧)))
      (htNew : t.val.domain l E o (Function.update K i ((K i)⟦r⟧))) :
    sNew ≫ (treeSystemShift l E o t K i r).hom =
      (treeSystemShift l E o e K i r).hom ≫ s⟦r⟧'
